targetPlatform.region: ohio (AWS us-east-2, co-located with Neon us-east-2)

vercelObservationSummary.note: Vercel env pull and REST API (?decrypt=false) cannot read back Sensitive Production values. Metadata listing enumerates key names/scopes only, never secret values.

githubActionsSecretReferences: YAKFI_TEST_CUSTOMER_BOT_TOKEN (repo secret, updated ~4 days ago; maintenance/HMAC signer only)
PRODUCTION_DATABASE_URL (Production environment secret, updated ~17 days ago; overrides repo secret)
YAKFI_PRODUCTION_CREDENTIAL_MASTER_KEY (repo secret, updated ~3 days ago; failed recovery candidate on 2026-11-13, NOT proven valid)
preservedInactiveLegacyDataset.policy: Preserve intact as inactive recovery data; never reset, overwrite, or migrate.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Prisma PostgreSQL connection string (@prisma/adapter-pg) for the selected active Neon dataset (?sslmode=require)
variables.recoverySource: Neon Console (Project -> Connect for ep-little-mouse-a5nh644n-pooler.us-east-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb) OR GitHub Actions repo secret TEST_DATABASE_URL via reviewed render-migration-ops.yml
variables.replacementImpact: Switching DB changes visible dataset and invalidates sessions; rotating Neon password breaks any runner/preview still holding the old string until updated
variables.nextAction: Verify in Neon Console or run render-migration-ops.yml inspect-sources + verify-selected-runtime, back up to owner vault, then install on Render

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
variables.purpose: Better Auth session/cookie signing secret (>= 32 chars)
variables.recoverySource: Owner password-manager vault (if previously saved) OR fresh 48-byte CSPRNG generation backed up to owner vault before Render installation (Vercel Sensitive value is non-readable)
variables.replacementImpact: Invalidates prior browser cookies only (cookies are already origin-bound and do not carry across vercel.app -> onrender.com); zero impact on DB rows or fp:<id> credentials
variables.nextAction: Generate 48-byte base64 secret locally, store in owner vault first, then set in Render service env

variables.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
variables.purpose: Better Auth canonical HTTPS baseURL for session callbacks, CSRF, and Secure cookie attributes
variables.recoverySource: Assigned Render service HTTPS origin (https://<service>.onrender.com or verified custom HTTPS domain)
variables.replacementImpact: Must match exact public HTTPS origin (no trailing slash); mismatch causes 403 origin rejection or sign-in redirect loops
variables.nextAction: Record exact Render HTTPS URL in vault/inventory and set equal to NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL before final build

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
variables.purpose: Canonical public HTTPS origin inlined into Next.js client bundle at build time, Better Auth trustedOrigins, and webhook/OAuth callback derivation
variables.environment: Render Production (build + server + client; corresponds to the 1 non-Sensitive Config/Encrypted variable in Vercel)
variables.recoverySource: Assigned Render service HTTPS origin (https://<service>.onrender.com or verified custom HTTPS domain)
variables.replacementImpact: Inlined at next build time; changing after build requires a fresh Render build + deploy before auth or webhook verification
variables.nextAction: Set exact HTTPS origin on Render BEFORE triggering the final Next.js build

variables.name: CREDENTIAL_MASTER_KEY
variables.purpose: 32-byte AES-256-GCM master key (64-char hex or 44-char base64) decrypting runtime_credentials fp:<id> records (including fixed customer bot @Drafnanafnanbot)
variables.recoverySource: Owner vault (Preview/test-compatible key) OR GitHub Actions repo secret CREDENTIAL_MASTER_KEY via reviewed render-migration-ops.yml (legacy Vercel Prod key is non-readable and failed test-DB preflight)
variables.replacementImpact: CRITICAL: wrong or newly generated key fails closed (GCM auth tag mismatch -> UNAUTHORIZED_CREDENTIALS) for all existing fp:<id> rows. Never generate a replacement blindly; if unrecoverable, selectively re-link @Drafnanafnanbot via repair-test-bot-credential.py while keeping historical rows intact
variables.nextAction: Run verify-selected-runtime to prove HEALTHY_LOCAL_KEY on active Neon test DB, export encrypted owner bundle via render-migration-ops.yml, verify restoration locally, then transfer to Render

variables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Primary OpenRouter LLM API key referenced by name in platform AI policy and JEV/shadow adapters
variables.recoverySource: Owner vault OR OpenRouter Dashboard (create a dedicated Render key with spend limit and save to vault first; Vercel Sensitive value is non-readable)
variables.replacementImpact: Safe to issue a dedicated key in OpenRouter console because DB AI policy stores only the reference name OPENROUTER_API_KEY; requires Render redeploy/restart when changed
variables.nextAction: Retrieve from vault or mint dedicated bounded key in OpenRouter console, back up to vault first, then set in Render

variables.name: TELEGRAM_MANAGER_BOT_TOKEN
variables.purpose: BotFather Manager Bot token for Telegram Managed Bot onboarding (getManagedBotToken / replaceManagedBotToken)
variables.recoverySource: Owner vault OR @BotFather (Manager Bot settings — do NOT revoke unless unrecoverable; not needed for existing customer bot @Drafnanafnanbot)
variables.replacementImpact: Unset disables only NEW managed-bot provisioning at /settings/telegram; existing customer bot @Drafnanafnanbot uses fp:<id> and works without it. Rotating in BotFather invalidates any active manager webhook until re-registered
variables.nextAction: Copy existing token from vault/@BotFather into vault + Render if new bot onboarding is needed; never rotate unnecessarily

variables.name: TELEGRAM_MANAGER_BOT_USERNAME
variables.purpose: Public @username of the Telegram Manager Bot used to construct https://t.me/<username>?start=<token> onboarding links
variables.recoverySource: @BotFather / Telegram profile OR Vercel metadata inspection
variables.replacementImpact: Non-secret; while unset, /settings/telegram reports manager bot unconfigured instead of minting deep links
variables.nextAction: Set alongside TELEGRAM_MANAGER_BOT_TOKEN when enabling Managed Bot onboarding on Render

variables.name: AGENTROUTER_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Secondary fallback AI provider API key referenced by platform AI policy
variables.recoverySource: Owner vault OR AgentRouter console (verify via Vercel metadata list whether configured among the 25 Production vars)
variables.replacementImpact: When unset, secondary fallback to AgentRouter is unavailable; primary OpenRouter turns still operate
variables.nextAction: Check Vercel env key-name metadata list; configure from vault/provider console only if used in active AI policy

variables.name: ATRIA_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Optional Discovery AI provider key resolved only if platform AI policy selects atria
variables.recoverySource: Owner vault OR Atria console (verify presence via Vercel metadata list)
variables.replacementImpact: Unused unless platform AI policy explicitly routes to atria
variables.nextAction: Leave unset unless Vercel metadata list and active AI policy confirm usage

variables.name: CODECRAFT_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Optional Discovery OpenAI-compatible AI provider key (had key failure recorded 2026-11-13 in DECISIONS #89)
variables.recoverySource: Owner vault OR CodeCraft console (verify presence via Vercel metadata list)
variables.replacementImpact: Unused unless platform AI policy selects codecraft
variables.nextAction: Leave unset unless explicitly re-enabled by owner

variables.name: INBOUND_WEBHOOK_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Shared bearer/header secret gating provider-neutral POST /api/conversations/inbound (>= 32 chars)
variables.recoverySource: Owner vault (check Vercel metadata list for presence)
variables.replacementImpact: While unset, /api/conversations/inbound safely returns 503; Telegram and Meta webhooks do not use this token
variables.nextAction: Keep unset on Render unless external provider-neutral ingress is explicitly authorized

variables.name: FLOWPILOT_TEST_INGRESS_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Operator test ingress token for POST /api/conversations/inbound (TEST traffic pool)
variables.recoverySource: Owner vault (check Vercel metadata list for presence)
variables.replacementImpact: While unset, dedicated operator test ingress stays disabled (503)
variables.nextAction: Keep unset unless operator test ingress is needed; if created, store in vault first

variables.name: WHATSAPP_META_VERIFY_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Meta webhook GET verification token (hub.verify_token) for /api/whatsapp/meta
variables.recoverySource: Owner vault OR Meta App Dashboard -> WhatsApp -> Configuration
variables.replacementImpact: Required only when verifying/re-pointing Meta WhatsApp webhook to Render URL
variables.nextAction: Recover from vault/Meta Dashboard before any future WhatsApp webhook cutover

variables.name: WHATSAPP_META_APP_SECRET
variables.purpose: Meta App Secret for X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC validation on POST /api/whatsapp/meta and Embedded Signup OAuth code exchange
variables.recoverySource: Meta App Dashboard -> App Settings -> Basic -> App Secret (or owner vault)
variables.replacementImpact: Do NOT reset App Secret in Meta Dashboard unless compromised; copy existing value into vault + Render when enabling Meta WhatsApp
variables.nextAction: Read from Meta App Dashboard into owner vault when Meta WhatsApp is configured on Render

variables.name: WHATSAPP_META_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Fallback system Meta Graph API permanent access token (when per-connection credentialsRef is not used)
variables.recoverySource: Owner vault OR Meta Business Settings -> System Users (check Vercel metadata list for WHATSAPP_META_TOKEN_* env names)
variables.replacementImpact: Affects only ENV-backed WhatsApp test connections lacking their own WHATSAPP_META_TOKEN_<KEY>
variables.nextAction: Inspect Vercel env key names + active DB whatsapp_connections.credentialsRef; re-issue Meta system token only if needed

variables.name: WHATSAPP_META_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
variables.purpose: Fallback Meta Graph API phone_number_id when connection externalId is absent
variables.recoverySource: Meta App Dashboard -> WhatsApp -> API Setup
variables.replacementImpact: Per-connection WhatsAppConnection.externalId takes precedence when present
variables.nextAction: Copy from Meta Dashboard if fallback WhatsApp number is used

variables.name: WHATSAPP_META_APP_ID
variables.purpose: Meta App ID prerequisite for Meta Embedded Signup onboarding
variables.recoverySource: Meta App Dashboard -> App Settings -> Basic -> App ID
variables.replacementImpact: While unset, Meta Embedded Signup stays safely on deterministic stand-in
variables.nextAction: Set from Meta Dashboard and register <NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL>/whatsapp-onboarding/callback when enabling Embedded Signup

variables.name: WHATSAPP_META_EMBEDDED_SIGNUP_CONFIG_ID
variables.purpose: Meta Embedded Signup config_id prerequisite for OAuth onboarding
variables.recoverySource: Meta App Dashboard -> WhatsApp -> Embedded Signup Configurations
variables.replacementImpact: While unset, Meta Embedded Signup stays safely on deterministic stand-in
variables.nextAction: Set from Meta Dashboard when enabling Embedded Signup

variables.name: WHATSAPP_META_API_VERSION
variables.purpose: Meta Graph API version string (defaults to v21.0 in code)
variables.recoverySource: Code default (v21.0)
variables.replacementImpact: Omit to use default v21.0
variables.nextAction: Leave unset unless pinning a newer Graph API version

variables.name: APPOINTMENT_REMINDERS_ENABLED
variables.purpose: Global operational switch for appointment reminders (disabled by default during Discovery)
variables.recoverySource: Approved operational policy (keep disabled unless separately approved)
variables.replacementImpact: Enabling without an approved scheduler and channel acceptance would dispatch outbound reminders; MUST remain unset or false
variables.nextAction: Keep unset (disabled) on Render; add no cron job

variables.name: CRON_SECRET
variables.purpose: Bearer/header secret authenticating /api/cron/appointment-reminders
variables.recoverySource: Not required while reminders remain disabled (unset fails closed with 401 in production)
variables.replacementImpact: When unset in NODE_ENV=production, /api/cron/appointment-reminders rejects all requests with HTTP 401
variables.nextAction: Leave unset so cron route fails closed until reminders are separately approved

variables.name: FLOWPILOT_JEV_SEMANTIC_ENABLED
variables.purpose: Semantic JEV authority switch in AI factory
variables.recoverySource: Vercel Production env key-name metadata inspection via render-migration-ops.yml inspect-sources + owner confirmation
variables.replacementImpact: Changing this value alters Conversation Engine semantic JEV authority and AI call behavior; NEVER guess or set silently
variables.nextAction: Keep unset and recorded as UNKNOWN until Vercel metadata inspection / owner confirms prior Production state

variables.name: FLOWPILOT_JEV_APPROVED_MONTHLY_BUDGET
variables.purpose: Production monthly budget gate required before type-safe JEV can activate in production
variables.recoverySource: Vercel Production env key-name metadata inspection + owner budget decision
variables.replacementImpact: Setting a budget unlocks live production JEV model spend; keeping unset blocks unbudgeted JEV spend safely
variables.nextAction: Do NOT set silently; leave unset until owner explicitly approves a JEV monthly budget

variables.name: FLOWPILOT_JEV_SHADOW_ENABLED
variables.purpose: Concurrent non-authoritative JEV shadow evaluation switch
variables.recoverySource: Vercel Production env key-name metadata inspection + owner confirmation
variables.replacementImpact: Enabling triggers extra sampled OpenRouter calls (extra AI spend); NEVER enable silently
variables.nextAction: Keep unset and recorded as UNKNOWN unless owner explicitly authorizes shadow spend

variables.name: SHADOW_SALT
variables.purpose: Deterministic sampling salt for JEV shadow mode (code default flowpilot.jev-shadow.v1)
variables.recoverySource: Vercel Production env key-name metadata inspection
variables.replacementImpact: Changing salt changes sampled subset when shadow mode is enabled; dormant while shadow is off
variables.nextAction: Keep unset unless shadow mode is explicitly configured

variables.name: SHADOW_SAMPLE_RATE
variables.purpose: Sampling rate (0..1) for JEV shadow mode
variables.recoverySource: Vercel Production env key-name metadata inspection
variables.replacementImpact: Controls shadow OpenRouter spend if shadow mode is enabled; dormant while shadow is off
variables.nextAction: Keep unset unless shadow mode is explicitly configured

variables.name: SHADOW_MAX_CALLS_PER_DAY
variables.purpose: Process-local daily call cap for JEV shadow mode
variables.recoverySource: Vercel Production env key-name metadata inspection
variables.replacementImpact: Bounds process-local shadow calls when shadow is enabled; resets on process restart
variables.nextAction: Keep unset unless shadow mode is explicitly configured

variables.name: JEV_SHADOW_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.purpose: Timeout in milliseconds for JEV shadow requests
variables.recoverySource: Vercel Production env key-name metadata inspection
variables.replacementImpact: Dormant while shadow mode is off
variables.nextAction: Keep unset unless shadow mode is explicitly configured

variables.name: FLOWPILOT_AI_GLOBAL_STOP
variables.purpose: Emergency global external-model kill switch halting all serving/JEV/shadow HTTP dispatches
variables.recoverySource: Operator control flag (default unset = normal serving allowed; malformed values fail closed)
variables.replacementImpact: Setting truthy halts all external AI calls and routes model turns to safe handoff; useful during backlog drain or incident stop
variables.nextAction: Leave unset for normal serving; set to true only during emergency AI stop or controlled backlog drain

variables.name: FLOWPILOT_AI_MAX_SERVING_ATTEMPTS
variables.purpose: Per-turn serving attempt ceiling (1..3, defaults to 3)
variables.recoverySource: Code default (3)
variables.replacementImpact: Lowering to 1 or 2 reduces retry/fallback attempts; malformed values fail closed
variables.nextAction: Leave unset unless tightening per-turn attempt cap

variables.name: CONVERSATION_CONTROL_MAX_ATTEMPTS
variables.purpose: Conversation Control retry ceiling within shared serving session
variables.recoverySource: Code default
variables.replacementImpact: Bounded by FLOWPILOT_AI_MAX_SERVING_ATTEMPTS hard ceiling (3)
variables.nextAction: Leave unset

variables.name: TURN_EVIDENCE_DISABLED
variables.purpose: Kill switch silencing structured turn-evidence log and OTLP emission
variables.recoverySource: Code default (unset = emit structured JSON log line)
variables.replacementImpact: Setting 1/true suppresses turn.evidence@v1 runtime logs
variables.nextAction: Leave unset so Render captures structured turn evidence in stdout logs

variables.name: OTEL_TURN_EVIDENCE_ENABLED
variables.purpose: Enables optional OTLP/HTTP-JSON export of turn-evidence records
variables.recoverySource: Vercel Production env key-name metadata inspection
variables.replacementImpact: No-op without OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
variables.nextAction: Leave unset unless OTLP sink is confirmed in Vercel metadata

variables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
variables.purpose: OTLP/HTTP base URL for optional turn-evidence trace export
variables.recoverySource: Vercel Production env key-name metadata inspection + observability vendor console
variables.replacementImpact: Affects external OTLP telemetry export only; never affects customer turns
variables.nextAction: Leave unset unless confirmed in Vercel metadata and owner vault

variables.name: RENDER_GIT_COMMIT
variables.purpose: Exact 40-char deployed Git commit SHA injected automatically by Render runtime
variables.recoverySource: Automatically provided by Render on Git-backed deploys
variables.replacementImpact: Read by /api/health, /api/health/live, and /api/operator/cutover-readiness for exact-SHA release and cutover verification
variables.nextAction: Do not override manually; verify via GET /api/health after deploy

variables.name: PORT
variables.purpose: HTTP listening port injected by Render (default 10000)
variables.recoverySource: Automatically provided by Render; bound via next start --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT
variables.replacementImpact: Binding wrong interface/port causes Render deploy port-scan timeout
variables.nextAction: Use start:render script in render.yaml; no manual PORT override needed

variables.name: DEMO_MODE
variables.purpose: Dev/demo auto-seeding flag
variables.recoverySource: N/A
variables.replacementImpact: Must never be set on Production runtime
variables.nextAction: Ensure unset on Render

variables.name: FLOWPILOT_ENABLE_QA_HARNESS
variables.purpose: CI Playwright fixture route enablement flag
variables.environment: CI only (FORBIDDEN on Render Production; hard-blocked in code when RENDER=true)
variables.recoverySource: N/A
variables.replacementImpact: Hard-blocked in src/lib/qa-harness.ts when RENDER=true
variables.nextAction: Ensure unset on Render
